notes: family: point-salad-euro. Only a third-party rulebook transcription (RulesPal) could be reached; official PDF/BGG pages were not accessible, so values are not verified against the printed rulebook. Scoring happens in 3 Eclipses (each: Avenue of the Dead steps x lowest visible building value; furthest on Pyramid track +4; Pyramid steps x4/3/2 by Eclipse; mask sets 1/3/6/10/15/21/28; salary 1 cocoa per worker +1 per power 4-5 worker, -3 VP per unpaid cocoa). These are normally tracked on the VP track, so enter the final track value. Game may also end on finishing the Pyramid (triggers a final Eclipse). Deluxe Master Set expansion content (e.g. extra modules) not verified or modelled. Dark Eclipse variant reverses the last tiebreak (higher token number wins); solo Teotibot not modelled.
